result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.select_edges()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Select edges using a predicate function. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L5516-L5567){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.select_edges(predicate) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Applies a custom filter function to all edges, selecting those for which the predicate returns `True`. The predicate receives an Edge object with properties: `id`, `source`, `target`, `weight`, and other attributes. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [predicate]{.doc-parameter-name} : Function that takes an `Edge` object and returns `bool`. Should return `True` to select the edge. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Self for method chaining. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Select edges by weight threshold: ::: {#6afbbd31 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node("A") .add_node("B") .add_node("C") .add_node("D") .add_edge("A", "B", weight=0.3) .add_edge("B", "C", weight=0.8) .add_edge("C", "D", weight=0.6) .select_edges(lambda e: e.weight and e.weight > 0.5) ) count = graph.count_selected_edges() # Returns 2 count # Select edges by relationship type # graph.select_edges( # lambda e: e.attributes and e.attributes.get("rel") == "friend" # ) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 2 ``` ::: :::
